seo.title: Contact and book a call | HTH (Hub to Hub)
seo.description: Book a 30-minute call with HTH, send a project brief, or message us on WhatsApp. Email hubtohub12@gmail.com.

hero.heading: Tell us what you have. We'll show you what's missing.
hero.body: Book a call directly, or send a short brief and we'll get back to you with next steps.

success.heading: Thanks, we've got it.
success.body: Your brief is in. We'll reply by email or WhatsApp with next steps. If it's urgent, book a call below.

error.heading: That didn't send.
error.body: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again, or email us directly at

booking.heading: Book a call
booking.body: 30 minutes. We look at how leads reach you today and where they go cold.

whatsapp.heading: Prefer WhatsApp?
whatsapp.body: Message us directly. Same team, same response time.
